Fri, August 14, 2026 at 3:04 AM MST 6 min read

Key Points

  • Interested in Concentrix Corporation? Here are five stocks we like better.

  • AI bookings surged 400% year over year in Concentrix's second quarter, with Intelligent Experience revenue expected to reach about $120 million in annual recurring revenue by year-end. Management said deployments can initially reduce revenue but later improve client growth and operating income.

  • Accelerated offshoring is creating a larger-than-expected sales headwind, now estimated at 300 basis points versus the previously forecast 200 basis points. Concentrix expects the pressure to moderate to roughly 150–200 basis points annually after the current transition.

  • Concentrix expects $630 million–$650 million in free cash flow this year and plans to use most of it after dividends to reduce debt, targeting leverage below 2.6 times this year and about 2.2 times by fiscal 2027; share buybacks remain paused.

  • Concentrix: High Debt and Struggling Margins

Concentrix (NASDAQ:CNXC) said its investments in artificial intelligence are reshaping its customer-experience business, with management emphasizing higher-margin technology and services revenue even as near-term sales growth faces pressure from accelerated offshoring and selected client spending changes.

Speaking at a Canaccord event, Chief Executive Officer Chris Caldwell described Concentrix as a global customer-experience provider operating in about 75 countries with revenue of just under $10 billion. He said the company's work extends beyond call centers and includes designing customer-experience systems, implementing the technology behind them, and providing the associated services.

→ Lumentum Just Delivered the AI Growth Investors Wanted

Caldwell said the company has long-standing client relationships, with its top 25 customers averaging roughly 18 years of tenure. He also highlighted geographic diversification, saying approximately one-third of revenue comes from North America-based clients, one-third from Europe-based clients, and one-third from Asia-Pacific-based clients. Its top 10 clients account for less than 20% of revenue, he said.

AI bookings rise as company prioritizes margin expansion

While Caldwell characterized recent revenue growth as "relatively anemic," he said Concentrix is making progress in deploying its Intelligent Experience, or IX, offerings. AI solution contract bookings increased 400% year over year in the company's second quarter, according to Caldwell.

→ Ryman Checks Into a $1.38B Hospitality Upgrade

The IX suite includes fully autonomous tools that can handle customer interactions such as calls and chats, as well as AI tools designed to augment employees and improve productivity. Caldwell said the company is seeing its strongest momentum in the human-augmentation category, where customers can see operational savings and process improvements from technology deployments.

市场节奏

2026 年 8 月 14 日星期五凌晨 3:04（MST） 阅读 6 分钟

要点

  • 对 Concentrix 公司感兴趣？ 这是我们更喜欢的五只股票。
  • Concentrix 第二季度的人工智能预订量同比激增 400%，预计到年底智能体验收入将达到年度经常性收入约 1.2 亿美元。 管理层表示，部署最初可能会减少收入，但随后会提高客户增长和运营收入。
  • 加速的离岸外包正在造成大于预期的销售逆风，目前估计为 300 个基点，而之前预测为 200 个基点。 Concentrix 预计，在目前的转型之后，每年的压力将放缓至约 150-200 个基点。
  • Concentrix预计今年的自由现金流为6.3亿至6.5亿美元，并计划在股息后使用其中大部分来减少债务，目标今年杠杆率低于2.6倍，到2027财年约为2.2倍；股票回购仍暂停。
  • Concentrix：高额债务和艰难的利润率

Concentrix（纳斯达克股票代码：CNXC）表示，其对人工智能的投资正在重塑其客户体验业务，管理层强调更高利润的技术和服务收入，尽管近期销售增长面临加速离岸外包和特定客户支出变化的压力。

首席执行官 Chris Caldwell 在 Canaccord 活动上发表讲话时将 Concentrix 描述为一家全球客户体验提供商，业务遍及约 75 个国家，收入略低于 100 亿美元。 他表示，该公司的工作不仅限于呼叫中心，还包括设计客户体验系统、实施其背后的技术以及提供相关服务。

→ Lumentum 刚刚实现了投资者想要的人工智能增长

Caldwell 表示，该公司拥有长期的客户关系，前 25 位客户的平均服务年限约为 18 年。 他还强调了地域多元化，表示大约三分之一的收入来自北美客户，三分之一来自欧洲客户，三分之一来自亚太客户。 他表示，其前 10 名客户的收入占收入的比例不到 20%。

随着公司优先考虑利润扩张，人工智能预订量增加

虽然考德威尔将最近的收入增长描述为“相对乏力”，但他表示 Concentrix 在部署其智能体验（IX）产品方面正在取得进展。 Caldwell 表示，该公司第二季度的人工智能解决方案合同预订量同比增长 400%。

→ Ryman 检查 $1.38B 酒店升级

IX 套件包括完全自主的工具，可以处理呼叫和聊天等客户交互，以及旨在增强员工能力和提高生产力的人工智能工具。 考德威尔表示，该公司在人类增强领域看到了最强劲的势头，客户可以看到技术部署带来的运营成本节省和流程改进。
